metadata.objective: Freeze the Phase 3 provider/runtime/frontend foundations and deliver one bounded canonical character-renderer leaf without transferring public API, network, security, lifecycle, or integration authority from Main.
metadata.dirty_state: Pre-existing user-owned edits: README.md, docs/OPERATIONS.md, docs/P2_FOUNDATION_HANDOFF.md, docs/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, docs/SUBAGENT_EXECUTION_PLAYBOOK.md, tests/contract/test_phase2_closure_spec.py. Campaign must not modify them.

reasons: Phase 3 crosses provider network, secret, runtime persistence, SSE, answer validation, accessibility, and producer-consumer boundaries that remain Main-owned.
The approved playbook exposes the canonical character renderer as a disjoint presentational leaf after the seven-state sprite contract is frozen.

rejected_modes.reason: It would ignore the owner's explicit authorization to use a Luna max subagent for a safely bounded implementation leaf.
A leaf-only architecture cannot own the Phase 3 provider, secret, readiness, SSE, and lifecycle seams that must precede later visitor integration.

capability_cards.repository_access: D:/RepoNPC shared workspace; exact-path ownership enforced by dispatch and fingerprint guard
evidence: Host role declaration fixes luna_worker to gpt-5.6-luna with max reasoning effort
known_limits: Worker has no authority over public contracts, application lifecycle, API/SSE clients, sprite validation, or integration

capability_cards.repository_access: D:/RepoNPC shared workspace; exact-path ownership enforced by frozen dispatch and fingerprint guard
evidence: Host accepted an explicit gpt-5.6-terra max worker spawn after the Luna pre-delta timeout retry was exhausted
known_limits: Fallback inherits the same exact three-file scope and has no authority over lifecycle, API, i18n, dependencies, or integration

current_state_evidence.observation: Phase 2 already freezes identity, query, and passage embedding methods but does not define Phase 3 health ownership or the chat provider contract.
A deterministic provider mock already exposes health, capabilities, generation, normalized failures, and mutation accounting without outbound network access.
FastAPI owns runtime initialization, bundle polling, same-origin built web serving, request IDs, and public security headers; provider lifecycle is not yet attached.
The current frontend is a bilingual semantic setup shell and contains no character renderer or chat lifecycle controller.
Focused Python baseline passed 22 and skipped 2 using a workspace basetemp; pnpm web format/lint/typecheck/unit/build passed; git diff --check passed with line-ending warnings only.

control_flow.failure_path: Stable safe provider error category; never expose upstream body or choose a fallback adapter.
Invalid state is prevented by the frozen type; reduced motion renders frame zero and accessible state text remains present.
Setup/degraded status remains safe and same-origin; this campaign does not attach provider network clients.

interfaces.contract: RepoNPC-owned typed capabilities, messages, result, usage, health, and stable error categories matching Technical Specification section 13.1; no adapter fallback semantics live in the interface.
The Phase 2 EmbeddingProvider identity/query/passage contract is extended only with health for runtime ownership; identity semantics are not redefined.

Inputs are one of idle, walk, listen, think, talk, success, offline; canonical 4x7 sheet URL; accessible state label; reduced-motion flag; optional frame 0-3 and duration 80-1000 ms. Output is a semantic labeled 32x32 crop using row order from ADR-014 and no lifecycle decisions.

lifecycle.rule: This campaign freezes interfaces only; provider construction, health polling, retries, shutdown, and readiness attachment remain later Main-owned work.
The leaf renders a supplied state; it never chooses or transitions state.

state_transitions.to: same supplied CharacterState rendered at frame zero or an allowed animation frame
state_transitions.forbidden: Choosing listen, think, talk, success, or offline from application events.

failure_boundaries.behavior: Only stable categories authentication, rate_limit, timeout, unavailable, invalid_response, and context_overflow cross the boundary; exception text is generic.
The renderer accepts frozen typed state and asset inputs; sprite validation, network loading policy, and lifecycle error recovery remain outside the leaf.

invariants.statement: All future chat adapters share one strict RepoNPC-owned capability/result/health/error contract and runtime embedding reuses the Phase 2 identity contract.
invariants.enforcement_owner: Typed provider protocols and deterministic contract tests
invariants.prohibited_behavior: An adapter invents a different result shape, exposes upstream exception text, or redefines embedding identity semantics.
invariants.counterexample: Construct a provider error with a private URL in its cause and observe that string conversion contains the URL or an unknown failure category is accepted.
phase_exit: Provider foundation types pass strict contract tests and type checking.

invariants.statement: The existing same-origin frontend and public setup boundary remain intact and built assets contain no provider secret or private URL canary.
invariants.enforcement_owner: FastAPI static route and secret-canary integration test
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Browser assets receive server-only provider configuration or require broad CORS.
invariants.counterexample: Build the frontend with recognizable provider canaries and find either canary in dist or a cross-origin provider fetch in the component leaf.
phase_exit: Existing static web integration and secret scan continue passing.

invariants.statement: The renderer maps all seven canonical states to rows 0-6, frames to columns 0-3, disables motion at frame zero when reduced motion is requested, preserves pixel rendering, and exposes an accessible state label.
invariants.enforcement_owner: Frozen CharacterState mapping plus deterministic component and static-markup tests
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Wrong row/order, smoothing, reduced-motion animation, unlabeled visible state, or lifecycle transition ownership in the leaf.
invariants.counterexample: Render offline with reduced motion and observe a nonzero row, nonzero frame, active animation, or no accessible label.
phase_exit: Focused renderer tests and aggregate web gates pass after Main inspection.

invariants.statement: The Luna worker changes only its three exact owned files and does not overwrite pre-existing user edits or campaign control artifacts.
invariants.enforcement_owner: Dispatch fingerprint and Main delta guard
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Any worker change outside the character renderer component, stylesheet, and focused test.
invariants.counterexample: The handoff changes App.tsx, package manifests, i18n contracts, normative docs, or an existing user-modified path.
phase_exit: Fingerprint guard reports no unauthorized path delta.

dispatches.authorization_source: Owner explicitly requested Luna max subagent implementation for Phase 3 and Terra fallback if quality is poor; Luna exhausted the permitted pre-delta timeout retry, so Terra executed the frozen fallback package.
dispatches.objective: Implement only the frozen canonical seven-state accessible character renderer leaf and its focused tests.
frozen_contracts: CharacterState is exactly idle|walk|listen|think|talk|success|offline mapped in that order to rows 0-6 of a 128x224 sheet containing 32x32 frames in four columns.

CharacterRenderer receives assetUrl, state, stateLabel, reducedMotion, optional frame 0-3, optional frameDurationMs 80-1000, and optional className; it makes no lifecycle decisions and performs no fetch.
Reduced motion always renders column zero and disables animation. Normal motion begins deterministically at the supplied frame and uses pixelated nearest-neighbor rendering.
Rendered output has an accessible state label while decorative internal crop markup is hidden from duplicate accessibility exposure. CSS must not contain remote URLs or smoothing.
Invalid frame/duration values are rejected by exported pure helpers or normalized deterministically as specified by tests; no public API or i18n contract is changed.

expected_artifacts: Worker final handoff with exact changed paths, commands, exit codes, observations, and implemented or blocked status
stop_conditions: Stop as blocked if any unowned path, dependency, lifecycle decision, shared i18n/API contract, or public behavior change is required.
Do not modify existing user changes or campaign control artifacts.
Report implemented only after every focused command exits zero.

Stop and ask the owner before changing a public endpoint, SSE event, stable error code, environment variable, trust boundary, provider fallback behavior, hosted dependency, sprite contract, or v1 scope.
Stop worker execution when any unowned path or Main-owned lifecycle/security decision is required.
Switch implementation repair to Terra only after a deterministic focused or aggregate quality failure, unauthorized delta, or Main inspection finding demonstrates inadequate Luna output.

triggers: One failed precise repair of a critical invariant
Main would need to rewrite more than 60 percent of worker-owned changed lines
Luna quality is deterministically inadequate, in which case the owner-authorized Terra worker receives a newly frozen repair package
